You made your choices and now you are but the lonely messenger, This years designated "Sacrifice" if need be. Many have come before you, all similarly selected. Criminals or exiles, all tasked with simply conversing with the ancient dragon atop the mountain and assuring a peaceful year to come

The wind is un-relenting, It feels as if its blowing through your very bones but you press on, Knowing that they are watching from far below and  if they see you turn back now, You'd be dead when you got home...

Eventually you reach the top, A large open entrance leading into the rumored cave stares back at you, The dragon isnt anyone in sight but you know he must be here, He's only been spotted leaving it once in all of the villages history and considering the view the villagers had of his...
